name: Pangangaso
description: A hunters' camp at the forest's edge, for wild boar and deer. Hunting the same woods too hard thins the game for a while. Hunters nearby also keep boar out of the fields.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
Costs, staffing and yields are playtest guesses (npm run simulate)
